newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Sept 6.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers firmed on the sudden re-appearance of shipowners after a week's absence. Bunker 180 cst was traded at $119.50 with quotes at $119-$120, up from Thursday's levels of $117-$120. Bunker 380cst also firmed to $116-$117.50 from $113-$116, MDO to $200-$205 from $196-$202 and gas oil to $215-$216 from $209-$213. But by late Friday, sellers withdrew as cargoes firmed but shipowners were "not biting"--Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703086).
